---
title: "Read single-cell input formats"
description: "Executable readers for 10x H5, 10x three-file directories, RDS, H5AD, Loom, and multi-sample inputs."
---

SCOP does not replace every low-level file reader. Use the format-native reader, create or convert a Seurat object, then enter the SCOP workflow. Always inspect dimensions, sparsity, feature names, barcode uniqueness, assay names, and metadata immediately after reading.

## 10x H5 {#10x-h5}

```r
library(Seurat)

raw <- Read10X_h5("filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
counts <- if (is.list(raw)) raw[["Gene Expression"]] else raw
srt <- CreateSeuratObject(counts, project = "study_name")

dim(srt)
sum(duplicated(rownames(srt)))
sum(duplicated(colnames(srt)))
```

The executed case reads the official PBMC 1k v3 H5: **33,538 features, 1,222 cells, 9,235,144 UMIs**, SHA-256 `8191f576…ffda`.

## 10x three-file directory {#10x-three-file-directory}

The directory must contain matching `matrix.mtx.gz`, `features.tsv.gz`, and `barcodes.tsv.gz` files.

```r
counts <- Read10X("filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")
srt <- CreateSeuratObject(counts, project = "study_name")
```

Do not read the three files independently and reorder one of them. The executed evidence reconstructs the three-file form from the real H5 and verifies both dimensions and total UMI count exactly.

## RDS {#rds}

```r
srt <- readRDS("object.rds")
stopifnot(inherits(srt, "Seurat"))
dim(srt)
Assays(srt)
Layers(srt[[DefaultAssay(srt)]])
head(srt[[]])
```

An RDS may already contain normalization, reductions, graphs, or stale identities. Treat it as an object to audit—not as proof that upstream processing was correct.

## H5AD and Loom {#h5ad-and-loom}

SCOP exports conversion helpers:

```r
srt_h5ad <- scop::h5ad_to_srt("object.h5ad")
srt_loom <- scop::loom_to_srt("object.loom")
```

In the audited runtime, the H5AD and Loom conversion backends (`zellkonverter`, `loomR`) were not installed, so this site does not claim an executed conversion. After conversion, explicitly compare:

```r
list(
  dimensions = dim(srt_h5ad),
  assays = Assays(srt_h5ad),
  metadata = colnames(srt_h5ad[[]]),
  reductions = Reductions(srt_h5ad)
)
```

Check whether raw counts, categorical metadata, embeddings, spliced/unspliced layers, and feature identifiers survived.

## Several samples

Read each sample separately and add stable sample-level metadata before merge:

```r
sample_dirs <- c(S01 = "data/S01/filtered_feature_bc_matrix",
                 S02 = "data/S02/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

objects <- lapply(names(sample_dirs), function(id) {
  x <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X(sample_dirs[[id]]), project = id)
  x$sample_id <- id
  x$condition <- c(S01 = "control", S02 = "treated")[[id]]
  x
})
names(objects) <- names(sample_dirs)

merged <- merge(objects[[1]], y = objects[-1], add.cell.ids = names(objects))
```

Do QC per sample before using a merged distribution; otherwise a low-quality sample can hide inside a global threshold.
